versions.changelog:
Initial release: Enables BSC (Binance Smart Chain) trading on Impossible Finance DEX with wallet creation, swap, token discovery, and funding features.

- Create a BSC wallet (private key + address in one file) for the agent.
- Register the wallet public key on Chromia to enable on-chain EVM event tracking.
- Discover available tokens and trading pairs, supporting any BEP-20 token with liquidity.
- Swap tokens using Impossible Finance V3 Swap (Uniswap V2 compatible, capital-efficient for stable pairs).
- User funding supported: send BNB and tokens to the agent’s BSC address for swaps and gas.
- Includes configuration steps, wallet management, and registration/gas top-up instructions.
